description: Step 3a acceptance expectations (docs/step3a_contract.md, 验收). Every item was checked against the source text on 2026-11-03: FDA labels from openFDA (set id, version, effective date below), GeneReviews from the local NCBI Literature Archive copy. Used by scripts/acceptance_step3a.py; the viewer only displays its result. match: case-insensitive regex on the action label or key; branch: regex on the branch disease label (omitted = every branch the action applies to); expect.status: applicable / conditional / not_applicable, or 'present' = the action is in that section with any status; expect.unknown: regexes, each must match a requirement whose result is unknown.

what.zh: SLC35A2 ex7 / 支持治疗兜底链：无 GeneReviews 章节，L3 已检索文献但无明确推荐 → 落到 L4 对症
what.en: SLC35A2 ex7 / supportive fallback: no GeneReviews chapter; L3 searched, no explicit recommendation -> L4 symptomatic

source.doc: PubMed: PMID 32103184 (Witters et al., Genet Med 2020), PMID 30746764 (Vals et al., J Inherit Metab Dis 2019), PMID 41373710 (review, Int J Mol Sci 2025); abstracts read via NCBI E-utilities 2026-11-05
source.quote: 32103184: "Oral galactose is well tolerated and shows promise as dietary therapy." (a 10-patient open-label study; no recommendation). 30746764: clinical, neuroradiological and biochemical features; no management advice. 41373710: "therapeutic perspectives including galactose supplementation" (perspective; the support check found no recommendation).

items.added: 2026-11-05: supportive fallback chain (contract docs/supportive_fallback_contract.md); proposed after reading the abstracts, approved

items.added: 2026-11-05: replaces the provisional '<ex>-dd-disabled' expectation. The category was disabled while AAP 2013 was unverified; AAP 2013 turned out to be a clinical report with no recommendation sentence in its abstract and an unverifiable reaffirmation status, so IAP 2022 (level 3, reason in the config) was approved instead and the category enabled. Quote checked character for character against the publisher PDF.
